skill.name: Vector Space Score Computation for Top-K Document Retrieval
skill.description: Canonical session skill that computes vector space similarity scores for all documents in a collection and retrieves the K documents with highest scores in descending order. Implements term-at-a-time accumulation to efficiently rank documents by vector space similarity to a query.
skill.objective: retrieve and rank top K documents by vector space similarity
applicable_signals: query submitted with one or more terms
document collection available with precomputed term frequencies and idf values
K (number of top results) specified and positive
contraindications: query is empty or contains no valid terms
document collection is not vectorized or indexed
postings lists do not contain term frequency data
triggers: need to find K best-matching documents for a query
typical K=10 for search engine result pages
document collection is vectorized and indexed
workflow_steps: {'step': 1, 'action': 'Initialize Length array with normalization factors for each of N documents'}
{'step': 2, 'action': 'Initialize Scores array with zero values for each of N documents'}
{'step': 3, 'action': 'For each query term t in the query, begin term-at-a-time accumulation loop'}
{'step': 4, 'action': 'Calculate the weight wt in the query vector for term t'}
{'step': 5, 'action': 'For each document d in the postings list of term t, retrieve tft,d and idf value'}
{'step': 6, 'action': 'Update Scores[d] by adding the contribution: wt × tft,d × idft'}
{'step': 7, 'action': 'Repeat steps 5-6 for all documents in the postings list'}
{'step': 8, 'action': 'After all query terms processed, normalize scores using Length array'}
{'step': 9, 'action': 'Use priority queue to extract the K documents with highest scores'}
{'step': 10, 'action': 'Return ordered list of K documents in decreasing score order'}
constraints: must store N/dft at the head of postings for term t to avoid precomputing idf
must store term frequency tft,d for each postings entry
score accumulators must be initialized to zero before processing
final top-K extraction requires a priority queue data structure
cautions: storing full floating-point weights in postings is space-inefficient; use idf precomputation and term frequency storage instead
term-at-a-time accumulation assumes all documents are scored; for large collections, consider approximation techniques
output_contract: Ordered list of K documents with highest vector space scores, ready for display or further processing. Each result includes document identifier and score value.
